source: CC-CEDICT (cedict.json via npm cedict-json package, equivalent to cedict_ts.u8)
ranking_source: HSK 3.0 word lists levels 1-9 (npm @leonsilicon/hsk3.0), then remaining CEDICT compounds in dictionary order
filter: 2-4 hanzi compound words only; skipped variant-of/surname/old-variant/see-also/CL-only entries

stages.stage: remaining CEDICT compounds (post-HSK), wave 1 of N
stages.ranking: CEDICT dictionary order (not frequency-ranked) — rare/classical/technical/proper-noun entries

remaining_batches_dir: scratchpad cedict_work/batches_all/ (b_016.json .. b_181.json still pending, ~500 words each, last batch b_181 has 315 words)
remaining_compounds_note: CEDICT compound words (2-4 hanzi) outside the HSK 1-9 vocabulary — mostly rare/classical/technical/proper-noun entries not covered by HSK. Being translated incrementally in waves per user request ('dịch được nhiêu dịch').
resume_instructions: remaining word list precomputed at scratchpad cedict_work/remaining_all.json (90315 records), pre-split into 500-word batches at scratchpad cedict_work/batches_all/b_NNN.json. To resume: pick next unprocessed b_NNN.json, translate via agent into out_NNN.tsv (same file naming convention), verify line count, append to cedict.vi.txt, update this file.
